description: Native iPhone and iPad console for herdr: watch and drive coding agents on your machines over SSH, in Herdr TUI or the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core), with a real libghostty terminal, native Chat, QR pairing, and push notifications when an agent needs you

### Added

- Open an image you sent to Claude Code or Codex by tapping its `[Image #N]` in your message, or with Preview Image in the message's menu, when it was pasted from a file, as Heeler's attached images are. (PR #674)
- Read Heeler in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan). On a Traditional Chinese device, or with Traditional Chinese chosen as Heeler's language, everything Japanese and Simplified Chinese cover presents in Traditional Chinese, permission prompts included. (PR #668)
- Read Heeler in Simplified Chinese. On a Simplified Chinese device, or with Simplified Chinese chosen as Heeler's language, everything Japanese covers presents in Chinese, permission prompts included. (PR #662)
- Find Heeler's language in Settings > Language, which names the language Heeler shows and opens Heeler's page in iOS Settings, where iOS keeps each app's language. (PR #662)
- Switch Claude Code's model and effort through Chat's title menu, under Model, with the current model on its second line beside a folder icon and the launch directory's last component. Permission mode stays beside the Composer. The native menu opens locally with fixed Opus, Sonnet, Haiku and Fable shortcuts, without probing the session or adding `/model` to the conversation merely by opening it. The title remains tappable while busy or switching; choices are enabled only while the Agent is Idle or Done and no send or switch is underway. Selecting sends `/model <alias>`; Claude Code resolves any user-configured third-party mapping and saves the selection as it normally does. Heeler does not configure mappings or verify provider availability. Permission modes cycle with Shift+Tab, bypass asks first, and effort uses `/effort`. The label changes only once the terminal confirms. (PR #647)
- Filter the Agents list from its filter icon, with a height-limited, independently scrolling Host section above Agent Status and a double-down chevron while more Hosts remain below. Hosts support multiple selections across Agents and Terminals; All Hosts clears only the Host selection. All Status clears only the status selection; Blocked, Working, Done and Idle show counts and allow multiple selections. The status filter is kept across launches, and a list it empties offers Show All. (PR #647)
- Pick up to 10 images at once in the Composer, staged one after another. The note that an image path was inserted and copied goes by itself after 2 seconds. (PR #647)
- Read Heeler in Japanese. On a Japanese device, or with Japanese chosen in the app's per-app language setting, the Console's tabs and lists, Chat, Changes, Usage, Settings, alerts, permission prompts, widgets, notifications and Live Activity labels

detail.readme:
# Heeler **A native iOS companion app for [herdr](https://herdr.dev) — an agent-first terminal runtime.** [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler?style=flat-square&color=E8B923&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/stargazers) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-6F42C1?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Swift](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-6-F05138?logo=swift&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://www.swift.org) [![iOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-18%2B-000000?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://developer.apple.com/ios/) [![App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App_Store-available-0D96F6?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/heeler-for-herdr/id6797263135) English | [简体中文](./README-zh.md) | [繁體中文](./README-zh-TW.md) | [日本語](./README-ja.md)
--- Heeler is an independent **herdr mobile client** and agent console for Claude Code, Codex, and other coding Agents on iPhone and iPad. Agents run on your own Hosts in Herdr TUI or the Herdr desktop app (herdr-core); Heeler connects over SSH. Monitor multiple Agents across machines, sorted by who needs you, then open a live terminal or supported Chat conversation to send instructions. ## Screenshots | Agent Console | Live terminal | Chat | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Keyboard | Changes | Terminals | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Skills | Hosts | Live Activity | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Usage | Widgets | Lock Screen widgets | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | [View iPad screenshots](docs/ipad-screenshots.md) ## Features - **Console** — every Agent on every machine in one status-sorted list (Blocked first), filterable by Host, updated live. - **Herdr desktop and herdr-core** — connect to the Herdr desktop app or headless herdr-core on macOS, Linux, and native Windows. The Console follows the desktop app's spaces and tabs, and live terminals, Chat, the Composer, New Agent, and New Workspace work there too ([Read more](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/herdr-core)). - **Attach** — the Agent's real terminal rendered by libghostty: native scrollback, momentum touch scrolling that also drives full-screen TUIs, long-press selection, takeover of a stale terminal owner, and quietly collected web links to open later. - **Chat** — read an Agent's conversation as native messages instead of a terminal screen, reply from the Composer, and answer a Blocked Agent with buttons; for Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Oh My Pi, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Antigravity CLI ([Read more](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/chat)). - **Composer** — draft locally with the full iOS keyboard (autocorrect, IME, dictation), then Send once; the tools keyboard adds Agent control keys, Agent Skills, reusable Snippets, and terminal appearance. Voice Input lets you speak to the Composer with your own speech service API key ([Read more](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/voice-input)). - **Terminal** — open a plain shell in the Agent's directory, with Text and Keys modes and one reused tab per Workspace. - **Attachments** — stage a photo or a file up to 64 MiB onto the Host over SFTP and insert its path into the draft. - **QR pairing** — scan a Pairing Code to add a machine; keys are generated on device, private keys stay in the Keychain, and the code pins the host key fingerprint. - **Notifications + Live Activities** — end-to-end encrypted pushes when an Agent goes Blocked or Done, and a lock-screen / Dynamic Island banner tracking Agents in real time; the relay can never read the content ([PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md)). - **Usage** — Claude Code and Codex Usage Limits with their reset times, and up to 30 days of Token Usage with its estimated API cost, across all Hosts or one; Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep them in view ([Read more](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/usage)). - **Worktrees** — start an Agent on a clean checkout of the workspace's repo. - **Appearance** — System, Light, or Dark; 30 themes with separate Light and Dark slots, worn by terminals, Chat and the app; bundled JetBrains Mono and IBM Plex Mono; pinch to zoom. - **Jump Host** — reach unroutable machines through an SSH jump, with keys verified at both hops. ## How it connects On macOS and Linux Hosts, Heeler speaks herdr's JSON API over SSH: each request opens a direct-streamlocal channel onto `herdr.sock`, one long-lived channel carries the event stream, and interactive terminals run `herdr agent attach --takeover` on an SSH PTY. The only prerequisites are SSH access and a running herdr — no server changes, no extra packages. The SSH server must allow stream-local forwarding (the OpenSSH default); onboarding calls it out when it's disabled. On Fedora, RHEL, and their derivatives, SELinux can deny the socket open even when forwarding is allowed — see [SELinux on a Fedora or RHEL Host](docs/guides/selinux.md). Native Windows Hosts (herdr >= 0.9.3) connect over SSH and are added manually. herdr-core Hosts, including machines running the Herdr desktop app, are added manually with their Server Kind confirmed. Heeler carries one framed link to the core: a direct-streamlocal channel onto its socket on macOS and Linux, or `herdr-core connect` over SSH exec on native Windows. Connecting never starts a core on macOS or Linux. The optional Host Helper adds notifications, Live Activities, and Usage on macOS and Linux ([Connect herdr-core](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/herdr-core)). For Tailscale, ZeroTier, or EasyTier access, follow the [Overlay Network setup guides](docs/guides/overlay-networks.md). They cover macOS installation, Tailscale without a VPN on the Mac, Heeler configuration, and connection checks. Heeler joins these networks inside the app without an iOS VPN configuration; you need a Heeler version with **Settings > Overlay Networks**. [View the Heeler setup screenshots](docs/guides/overlay-networks.md#heeler-setup-screenshots) for Tailscale, ZeroTier, and both EasyTier modes. Unroutable machines can sit behind an SSH Jump Host: - [Set up remote access step by step](docs/guides/vps-jump-host-setup.md) - [Architecture, security boundaries, and the VPS runbook](docs/guides/vps-jump-host.md) A Host can have several routes, such as its LAN address at home and an overlay network or Jump Host elsewhere: [Reach a Host on several routes](docs/guides/host-routes.md). ## Installation Install Heeler from the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/heeler-for-herdr/id6797263135) or [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/aXSxRn4r). - **macOS / Linux:** Install [herdr](https://herdr.dev/docs/install/), enable SSH, then follow the pairing steps below. - **Native Windows:** Follow the [Windows setup guide](docs/guides/windows-setup.md). - **Herdr desktop app / herdr-core:** Start the desktop app or herdr-core, enable SSH, then add the Host manually: [Connect herdr-core](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/herdr-core). Needs Heeler 0.1.18 or later. ## Adding a machine On a macOS or Linux machine running herdr (Node >= 20, herdr >= 0.7.5, OpenSSH server on — macOS: **System Settings > General > Sharing > Remote Login**): ```bash herdr plugin install ZingerLittleBee/Heeler --ref plugin --yes herdr plugin action invoke heeler.pair ``` Scan the Pairing Code QR it shows and the machine is added as a Host — the code carries the addresses, the host key fingerprint, and SSH key enrollment. The same [plugin](plugin/README.md) delivers the encrypted notifications once you enable them for the Host in the app. For every step, the popup's keys, and troubleshooting, see the [pairing guide](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/pairing). ## Opening an Agent from another app Another app can open an Agent in Heeler with a link: ```text heeler://agent?host=my-mac&session=work&pane=w1%3Ap1 ``` - `host` names a saved Host on that session: its address, or its name when no Host on the session has that address. Case is ignored. - `session` is the herdr session name. Leave it out, or pass `default`, for the default session. - `pane` is herdr's pane id. Leave it out to open the Console. Percent-encode each value, with `%20` for a space: a `+` stays a plus sign, so form encoding (such as JavaScript's `URLSearchParams`) misses a name like `Build Box`. When no saved Host on that session matches, or more than one does, the link opens the Console. ## Stack - SwiftUI, iOS 18+, iPhone and iPad. iPad support is restored in 0.1.8 with Magic Keyboard shortcuts, multiwindow, and drag and drop. - The repository-local `Packages/HeelerSSH` (libssh2 + OpenSSL) for SSH - [libghostty-spm](https://github.com/lakr233/libghostty-spm) for terminal emulation and Metal rendering See `docs/adr/` for why — the transport story in particular is not obvious. ## Contributing Issues and PRs are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for layout, build/test, and conventions. ## Status Released on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/heeler-for-herdr/id6797263135). It is not yet available in every country or region; where it is missing, the [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/aXSxRn4r) build stays available. Built for personal use first and shaped by daily driving, so expect rough edges and fast iteration. Not affiliated with the herdr project.
detail.readme_zh:
# Heeler **[herdr](https://herdr.dev) 的原生 iOS 伴侣应用 —— herdr 是一个 agent 优先的终端运行时。** [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler?style=flat-square&color=E8B923&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/stargazers) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/ci.yml?branch=main&label=CI&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/ZingerLittleBee/Heeler/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-6F42C1?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) [![Swift](https://img.shields.io/badge/Swift-6-F05138?logo=swift&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://www.swift.org) [![iOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/iOS-18%2B-000000?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://developer.apple.com/ios/) [![App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App_Store-available-0D96F6?logo=apple&logoColor=white&style=flat-square)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/heeler-for-herdr/id6797263135) [English](./README.md) | 简体中文 | [繁體中文](./README-zh-TW.md) | [日本語](./README-ja.md)
--- Heeler 是 iPhone 和 iPad 上独立的 **herdr 移动客户端**和 Agent 控制台，用于远程操作 Claude Code、Codex 和其他编程 Agent。Agent 在你自己的 Host 上通过 Herdr TUI 或 Herdr 桌面端（herdr-core）运行，Heeler 通过 SSH 连接。跨机器查看多个 Agent，按「谁需要你」排序，再打开实时终端或支持的 Chat 对话发送指令。 ## 截图 | Agent Console | 实时终端 | Chat | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Keyboard | Changes | Terminals | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Skills | Hosts | 实时活动 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | | Usage | 小组件 | 锁屏小组件 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | [查看 iPad 截图](docs/ipad-screenshots.md) ## 功能 - **Console** —— 所有机器上的 Agent 汇成一个按状态排序的列表（Blocked 排最前），可按 Host 过滤，实时更新。 - **Herdr 桌面端与 herdr-core** —— 连接 macOS、Linux 与 Windows 原生环境上的 Herdr 桌面端或无界面 herdr-core。Console 跟随桌面端的空间与标签页，实时终端、 Chat、Composer、New Agent 和 New Workspace 同样可用 （[了解更多](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/herdr-core)）。 - **Attach** —— libghostty 渲染的 Agent 真实终端：原生历史回看、也能驱动全屏 TUI 的惯性触摸滚动、长按选择、接管失效的终端占用者，并静默收集网页链接 供稍后打开。 - **Chat** —— 以原生消息而不是终端画面阅读 Agent 的对话，在 Composer 里 回复，并用按钮回答 Blocked 的 Agent；支持 Claude Code、Codex、Pi、 Oh My Pi、Grok Build、OpenCode 和 Antigravity CLI（[了解更多](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/chat)）。 - **Composer** —— 在本地用完整的 iOS 键盘起草（自动纠错、输入法、听写）， 一次 Send 投递；工具键盘另有 Agent 控制键、Agent Skills、可复用的 Snippets 和终端外观。 - **Terminal** —— 在 Agent 的目录打开普通 shell，带 Text / Keys 两种模式， 每个工作区复用同一个 tab。 - **附件** —— 把照片或最大 64 MiB 的文件经 SFTP 暂存到 Host，并把路径 插入草稿。 - **扫码配对** —— 扫描 Pairing Code 即可添加机器；密钥在设备上生成，私钥 不离开 Keychain，配对码同时固定 host key 指纹。 - **通知 + 实时活动** —— Agent 进入 Blocked 或 Done 时的端到端加密推送， 以及锁屏 / 灵动岛上实时跟踪 Agent 的横幅；中继永远读不到内容 （[PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md)）。 - **Usage** —— Claude Code 与 Codex 的 Usage Limits 及重置时间，以及最多 30 天的 Token Usage 和估算 API 费用，可汇总所有 Host 或只看一台；主屏和 锁屏小组件随时可见（[了解更多](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/usage)）。 - **Worktrees** —— 让 Agent 从工作区仓库的干净检出上启动。 - **外观** —— 跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色；30 个主题，浅色深色各有独立槽位， 终端、Chat 和整个 App 都使用它；内置 JetBrains Mono 与 IBM Plex Mono； 双指缩放字号。 - **跳板机** —— 经 SSH 跳板访问不可直连的机器，两跳各自校验密钥。 ## 连接原理 在 macOS 和 Linux Host 上，Heeler 通过 SSH 使用 herdr 的 JSON API：每个请求经 direct-streamlocal 通道直连 `herdr.sock`，一条长连接承载事件流，交互终端则在 SSH PTY 上运行 `herdr agent attach --takeover`。前提只有 SSH 访问和一个运行中的 herdr —— 不改服务器、不装额外软件包。SSH 服务器需允许 stream-local 转发 （OpenSSH 默认开启）；若被关闭，引导流程会明确指出。 Windows 原生 Host（herdr >= 0.9.3）通过 SSH 连接，需手动添加。 herdr-core Host（包括运行 Herdr 桌面端的机器）需手动添加，并确认 Server Kind。Heeler 与 core 之间只有一条分帧链路：macOS 和 Linux 上经 direct-streamlocal 通道直连 core 的套接字，Windows 原生环境上经 SSH exec 运行 `herdr-core connect`。在 macOS 和 Linux 上，连接本身绝不会启动 core。可选的 Host Helper 在 macOS 和 Linux 上提供通知、实时活动和 Usage（[连接 herdr-core](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/herdr-core)）。 如需通过 Tailscale、ZeroTier 或 EasyTier 访问机器，请参阅 [Overlay Network 设置教程](docs/guides/zh/overlay-networks.md)。教程涵盖 macOS 安装、Mac 上不装 VPN 的 Tailscale 方案、Heeler 配置和连接验证。Heeler 在应用内加入这些网络，无需配置 iOS 系统 VPN；需要带有 **Settings > Overlay Networks** 的 Heeler 版本。 [查看 Heeler 配置截图](docs/guides/zh/overlay-networks.md#heeler-配置界面截图)，包括 Tailscale、ZeroTier 以及 EasyTier 两种模式（Network 与 Config Server）的设置界面。 不可直连的机器可以放在 SSH 跳板机之后： - [逐步搭建远程访问](docs/guides/zh/vps-jump-host-setup.md) - [架构、安全边界与 VPS 迁移手册](docs/guides/zh/vps-jump-host.md) 一个 Host 可以有多条路由，例如在家用局域网地址，在外走 Overlay Network 或跳板机：[多路由使用教程](docs/guides/zh/host-routes.md)。 ## 安装 从 [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/heeler-for-herdr/id6797263135) 或 [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/aXSxRn4r) 安装 Heeler。 - **macOS / Linux：** 安装 [herdr](https://herdr.dev/docs/install/)，启用 SSH，再按下方步骤配对。 - **Windows 原生环境：** 参见 [Windows 设置指南](docs/guides/zh/windows-setup.md)。 - **Herdr 桌面端 / herdr-core：** 先启动桌面端或 herdr-core 并启用 SSH，再手动添加 Host，参见[连接 herdr-core](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/herdr-core)。需要 Heeler 0.1.18 或更高版本。 ## 添加机器 在运行 herdr 的 macOS 或 Linux 机器上（Node >= 20、herdr >= 0.7.5、已启用 OpenSSH 服务器 —— macOS 上是 **系统设置 > 通用 > 共享 > 远程登录**）： ```bash herdr plugin install ZingerLittleBee/Heeler --ref plugin --yes herdr plugin action invoke heeler.pair ``` 用应用扫描弹出的 Pairing Code 二维码，机器即被添加为 Host —— 地址、 host key 指纹和 SSH 密钥注册全部由配对码承载。在应用里为该 Host 启用通知 后，同一个[插件](plugin/README.md)负责投递加密通知。完整步骤、弹窗按键和排错 方法见[扫码配对指南](https://docs.heeler.bybee.dev/zh/pairing)。 ## 从其他应用打开 Agent 其他应用可以通过如下链接在 Heeler 中直接打开某个 Agent： ```text heeler://agent?host=my-mac&session=work&pane=w1%3Ap1 ``` - `host` 指定该会话下已保存的 Host：优先匹配地址，若该会话下没有匹配该地址的 Host，则匹配 Host 名称（忽略大小写）。 - `session` 是 herdr 会话名称。留空或传入 `default` 表示默认会话。 - `pane` 是 herdr 的窗格 ID（pane id）。留空则直接打开 Console。 请对每个参数值进行百分号编码，且空格需编码为 `%20`：`+` 会被保留为加号本身，因此表单编码（如 JavaScript 的 `URLSearchParams`）无法匹配像 `Build Box` 这样带空格的名称。如果该会话下没有匹配的已保存 Host，或匹配到多个 Host，链接会打开 Console。 ## 技术栈 - SwiftUI，iOS 18+，iPhone 与 iPad。0.1.8 恢复 iPad 支持，含 Magic Keyboard 快捷键、多窗口和拖放。 - 仓库内 `Packages/HeelerSSH`（libssh2 + OpenSSL）负责 SSH - [libghostty-spm](https://github.com/lakr233/libghostty-spm) 负责终端仿真与 Metal 渲染 选型依据见 `docs/adr/`，其中传输层方案经过多轮验证后才最终确定。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎 Issue 和 PR：仓库结构、构建与测试、提交约定见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 状态 已在 [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/heeler-for-herdr/id6797263135) 上发布；部分国家和地区尚未上架，可以继续使用 [TestFlight](https://testflight.apple.com/join/aXSxRn4r)。以个人日常使用打磨为先，仍有粗糙之处，迭代较快。与 herdr 项目无隶属关系。
